{{Top|leg}}
'''Ralmathen Corridor''' was a boulevard that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Neskroff/Legends|Neskroff]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] team became stranded on Isis and they attacked a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] security guards in Ralmathen Corridor.
